Under the maintainer's rule that every zh-CN demo-data issue is p1, platform side included. A composed bundle's seed datasets (`packages[i]` data) are never loaded on `install-local` install, reseed or upgrade. So the hosted HotCRM 6.4.0 tenant shows no demo data in 订单与回款 (`crm_o2c`) or 项目交付 (`crm_psa`). **p1** stands. A5 (install-local). server#5 is knocked.

Reproduced on a self-hosted 18.5.0 runtime with a different composed app (a HotCRM-derived app, six package bodies, its seed datasets and locale packs all inside `packages[i].manifest`), installed with `os package install ./dist/objectstack.json --token …`:

- install: 0 rows in every seeded object; `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/<id>/sample-data` answers `count: 0`;
- `POST …/reseed-sample-data` answers `400 RESEED_SKIPPED "Reseed did not run: no-datasets"`.

**The same gap also drops the translations.** `applySideEffects` (around line 6854 on main) collects i18n bundles only from the top-level `manifest.translations` and `manifest.i18n`:

```ts
if (Array.isArray(manifest?.translations)) bundles.push(...manifest.translations);
if (Array.isArray(manifest?.i18n)) bundles.push(...manifest.i18n);
```

In a composed artifact each package's locale packs sit in `packages[i].manifest.translations` (the artifact's top-level `i18n` is the config object, not a bundle array), so none is loaded. Measured result: the console's own chrome is in the viewer's zh-CN, while every app label (navigation, object and view labels, the app name) shows the English source. Ask 1 should cover `translations` beside `data`: read every package body's bundles, in package order.

Flattening the artifact before install is not a usable workaround once a composed install exists: re-installing the flattened body under the same id is refused with `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` (object name owned by the module package), and the composed install cannot be uninstalled to start over — filed separately.

Scope note · ask 2 moved to new cards · 2026-11-16T13:30Z

PR #34403 (`Fixes #34336`) builds ask 1: every install-local seed door reads a composed bundle's package datasets. Ask 2 is not built there, because its premise did not hold (os-dev-report 6917684209: an upgrade seeds the requesting organization only, and this door passes no `landedKeys`, for flat bundles too). By the seat's route it moved to two cards, so closing this card loses nothing:

- #34405 (p2): wire `landedKeys` into the door's existing seed loads, so a deleted seed row does not come back on reinstall or reseed.
- #34406 (needs-user-decision, p2): whether a managed upgrade replays new seed keys into every existing organization. Tenancy policy, for the maintainer.

The dev's out-of-scope findings of the same family (composed translations `translationsLoaded: 0`; the ADR-0120 global-unique gate reading top-level objects, code-read only) are on #34407.
